title: Deeper/broader BRL-CAD explicit-mesh consumer safety and admission refresh
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local plan/source/test reconciliation
scope: Refresh BRL-CAD's optional role as an independent 3D consumer of explicit DXF facets and meshes
Reconcile current and legacy converter-scope documentation with the open dxf-g POLYLINE face-index safety report and proposed fix
Refine the existing composed-checkpoint route so it remains safe, measurable, optional, and non-blocking

sources.observation: The guide describes dxf-g importing polygons/meshes into BOT primitives and mapping DXF layers to regions; absent unit metadata defaults to millimeters, and scale/tolerance options affect the conversion.
sources.limits: The documentation does not provide a current exact entity/version support matrix or executed result for any pinned build.

sources.observation: The older guide says dxf-g predates ACIS and converts 3DFACE and 3DMESH entities.
sources.limits: The guide is older than the current tutorial and cannot establish exact current behavior.

sources.observation: The report describes a full dxf-g import-path heap out-of-bounds read from untrusted POLYLINE face indices and includes an ASan trace.
sources.limits: Issue content is a reporter claim about BRL-CAD, not an independently reproduced finding in this workspace, a normative DXF rule, or evidence of a libdxfrw defect.

sources.observation: The proposed change says it adds in-range checks before face indices are passed to triangle generation and skips invalid faces; the PR was still open in the reviewed snapshot.
sources.limits: An open PR is not a released or verified fix and does not define the legal signed PFACE semantics.

sources.observation: 3DFACE and MESH are explicit DXF record families distinct from the modeler-geometry route.
sources.limits: These references do not qualify a BRL-CAD build or establish ACIS/B-rep semantics.

references: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing BRL-CAD explicit-mesh route and PAR-37/7V safety boundary
localReconciliation.observation: Existing generated local polyface controls cover signed indices, zero termination, advisory counts, child ordering, invalid ranges, and INT16_MIN. This review inspected source/test inventory only; it did not run these tests.
localReconciliation.limits: Local parser/writer correctness and test-source presence do not establish any BRL-CAD behavior.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Keep BRL-CAD as an optional composed-checkpoint candidate only for pinned, scratch-generated, safe 3DFACE/3DMESH profiles; exclude POLYLINE/PFACE until the open safety concern is resolved and a pinned released route is verified. Record converter aggregation, units, scale, tolerance, output geometry, and independent expected invariants. Do not use it as a parser-security, DWG, ACIS/AcDs, or B-rep oracle.

method.limitations: The BRL-CAD sources are documentation and issue/PR snapshots rather than a pinned, executed artifact. No peer geometry was generated or imported, and no security claim about the peer or local library follows from this plan update.
